snippet.title: Folk Hero — Multiplayer
snippet.description:
Explore the island with your friends!
Get Folk Hero: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342150/Folk_Hero/

⚔️ Folk Hero is an action-slasher with rogue-lite elements set in the world of Slavic fantasy. Explore the ever-changing island, find treasures, combine weapons and artifacts to defeat mythical enemies. Challenge your skills! One life, one try. 

🔗 Twitter:  https://twitter.com/folkherogame/ 
🔗 Instagram: https://twitter.com/folkherogame  
🔗 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thefolkherogame/ 
 
#folkhero
